_comment_include: Public repos with a live site or README screenshot are synced automatically; private repo metadata is included when a token can access it.
_comment_images: Order in which a preview image is looked for. readme = first screenshot in README.md, og = the live site's og:image, screenshot = a rendered screenshot of the live site, github = GitHub's auto-generated repo card.
_comment_starred: Repos you have starred on GitHub (other people's work), shown in their own section. A preview image is only used if the repo really has one, so the default order has no screenshot/github-card fallback. 'exclude' takes 'owner/name'.
_comment_overrides: Per-repo tweaks, keyed by repo name: title, category, liveLink, image (URL), tech (array), hidden (true to hide).
